summary: Completed backend-only testing of rescheduling enforcement feature for OnCall Foot marketplace. All 9 test scenarios passed successfully (100% success rate). The PATCH /api/bookings/:bookingId/status endpoint with status='rescheduled' correctly enforces all safety principles: client authorization, valid state transitions, provider availability, service availability, future datetime validation, provider overlap prevention, duplicate booking prevention, and consistent friendly error messages with no leaked database internals.
passed_tests: Test 1: Authorization - Non-owner client correctly rejected with 403
Test 2: Missing scheduledAt - Correctly rejected with 400 and proper error message
Test 3: Malformed datetime - Correctly rejected with 400 (NOT 500) with friendly error
Test 4: Past datetime - Correctly rejected with 400 mentioning 'future'
Test 5: Outside availability - Correctly rejected with 400 mentioning 'outside this provider's availability'
Test 6: Provider overlap - Correctly rejected with 409 and exact message, no leaked IDs or SQL
Test 7: Duplicate booking - Correctly rejected with 409 and exact message
Test 8: Happy path - Successfully rescheduled with status='rescheduled', updated scheduledAt, and NO careNotes field (client-safe projection)
Test 9: State machine - All state transitions working correctly (requested cannot be rescheduled by client, cancelled is terminal)
